item.title: Building a context-aware AI assistant on AgentCore and OpenClaw
item.description: Off-the-shelf AI assistants forget you between conversations. This post shows how to build a personal assistant that accumulates context using OpenClaw on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime, with AgentCore memory turning disposable chats into durable, structured knowledge you can retrieve with metadata filters. Worth a read for developers following AI and AWS. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/building-a-context-aware-ai-assistant-on-agentcore-and-openclaw

The newish CSS @container at-rule solves this by allowing styles to adapt based on the size of a specific parent container rather than the entire browser window. item.title: Introducing Anthropic models on Amazon Bedrock for in-region inference in Seoul and Singapore
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 with in-region inference in Seoul, and Claude Sonnet 5 in Singapore. If you have local data processing requirements in South Korea or Singapore, you can now use these Anthropic models at scale, with inference processed entirely within the Region you call. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/introducing-anthropic-models-on-amazon-bedrock-for-in-region-inference-in-seoul-and-singapore
